dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: If we were able to gain more an upper hand during the war, we could have used this matter as a bargaining chip.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: But since the peace talks are over, there's no point considering that what-if now.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: I must say that Sangonomiya Kokomi really is quite impressive...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: If a such a great disaster happened under another leader's watch, it would surely have hurt their image and restrained their next steps...

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: But she rooted out the people who performed the inside job and punished them swiftly and severely. If anything, this whole disaster became a way for her to consolidate her position.

dialogues.speaker: Kujou Masahito
dialogues.text: Considering that we were up against such a frightening foe... All the more do I not regret negotiating a peaceful settlement.
